item.title: By: Malcolm McLachlan
item.dc:creator: Malcolm McLachlan
item.description: What an incredible and moving story. There is so much that we lose out on in our busy lives today with the demands placed on us that we feel or believe are necessary to respond towards, when actually they are misleading and somehow miss the point entirely. My only wish now, at my age of 77 is that I had come in contact with this information much earlier in my life. I have been searching and trying out things which have petered out within me, maybe because they and I were somehow not matched, except that somehow I had felt very strongly that they had. I am so pleased to have read this amazing and beautiful story and would like to share it with others whom I know and love, especially my family. Thank you for allowing me this privilege, which I deeply value at this time in my life. And to Bill Plotkin whom I've been following through his books. Regards and much love. Malcolm McLachlan.
